Sample.evidence_source: A series of ANOVAs were conducted to assess whether the trait levels of key variables were significantly different between any of the conditions. Only trait levels of body anxiety significantly varied between conditions; specifically, participants in the health conditions had higher trait levels of body anxiety than those in the appearance conditions, F(1, 125) = 7.19, p = .01; health conditions: M = 2.87, SD = 1.09; appearance conditions: M = 2.40, SD = 0.98. The degrees of freedom F(1, 125) indicate a total sample size of 125 + 1 = 126.
